quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the 76ers' second-half turnaround against the Pacers
quotes.excerpt: You stop turning the ball over, play tougher. They were just way, way, way tougher than us first half.
quotes.quote: You stop turning the ball over, play tougher. They were just way, way, way tougher than us first half. Took the ball from us, they were just punking us honestly, and we did a good job of playing better the second half.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey on the 76ers second half turnaround against the Pacers: They were just way, way, way tougher than us first half. Took the ball from us, they were just punking us honestly, and we did a good job of playing better the second half.

structured.context: Tyrese Maxey discusses the 76ers' second-half turnaround after being outplayed by the Pacers in the first half.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the team's competitive nature and resilience
quotes.excerpt: This is a very competitive group. My only message that I had, I said, 'Well, it's time to see what we made of.'
quotes.quote: It was definitely disappointing our performance, disappointing that we turned the ball over, disappointing that we give up layups and dunks. I think I said it last game, this is a very competitive group. My only message that I had, I said, 'Well, it's time to see what we made of.' We're going to be some front-runners and give in and only be happy when stuff is good, or when stuff is bad, we're going to fight and be resilient. We did that.

structured.context: Tyrese Maxey reflects on the team's competitive nature and their response to a disappointing performance.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the versatility and impact of Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: He brings a just a different dynamic for our team, offensively and defensively.
quotes.quote: He brings a just a different dynamic for our team, offensively and defensively. It's a wrinkle that we could throw in there at any given moment. He can guard bigs, he can guard guards. Like tonight, I told him, 'Listen, I'm going to guard James, but third and fourth quarter, early on, I need you to score the ball, like be really aggressive.' And he did that, and that's easy for him, that's what he does.

quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on his communication and chemistry with Joel Embiid

quotes.quote: He's played a lot of basketball. So he's seen a lot of scenarios. So it's like I always will go up to him and ask him what he sees, or he'll ask me what I see, and we just kind of piggyback off of each other, trying to lead our lead this group and be kind of like quarterbacks out there on the on the court.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the team's unselfishness and aggressive play
quotes.excerpt: The biggest thing is we've been unselfish. Sometimes too unselfish.
quotes.quote: The biggest thing is we've been unselfish. Sometimes too unselfish. And we talked to each other about that, like Joel has been on everybody about just playing your games. But it's a good thing. It's a good thing. Like we're okay with I hate saying we're okay with some of those turnovers, because then it costs us in the first half, and then we were all just extremely aggressive in the in the second half, looking for our shot, looking for each other's shot, and that's good for us.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey on the team's competitive culture and lack of egos
quotes.excerpt: It's a lot of competitive guys in here. We don't have big-time names on the back of the jerseys.
quotes.quote: It's a lot of competitive guys in here. We don't have big-time names on the back of the jerseys, but not like big-time egos when it comes to competing. So it's like, you know, you say something like that, Joel will say something, and we all take it with a grain of salt because at the end of the day, LeBron not telling you something, he's the greatest of all times, or he tell you something that that you ain't trying to hear, or Joe, or Joel, or myself, or you know, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Dean, like all these guys have been competitive and play at a high level. So we just respect each other and we go out there and try to compete with each other.
quotes.social_post: Tyrese Maxey on the 76ers locker room culture: We don't have big-time names on the back of the jerseys, but not like big-time egos when it comes to competing. We just respect each other and we go out there and try to compete.
